evaluation: Leave-one-target-out over 5 SPHEREx fields (9-24 frames each), 10,000 test stamps per fold. Scores are from fold models; the shipped model is trained on all 5.
data: Fake changes added to real SPHEREx DR1/QR3 frames; before and after are one frame with fresh fake noise, not two visits. No real movers, no human labels.
selection: CNN chosen over trees on these same held-out folds and test stamps, so this is not an untouched benchmark.
limits: Labels change spots only; it does not find planets. Not tested on a real asteroid. Mover recall is 0.55 at S/N 3-5. A quarter of test stamps are movers; if real ones are rarer, more mover labels are wrong.
treesNote: Trees saw 600 stamps per class per target, the CNN 2,500: not like-for-like.
belowGate: Below the 0.85 target: mover recall at S/N>=10 on wise0855 0.725 (trees better); artifact precision on wise0855 0.747 (trees better).
